decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Planning permission ref: 2019/4915 has lawfully commenced within 3 years of the date of the permission. 
Condition : 2 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the reports, specifications and drawings detailed 851-10-098-PL01, 851-10-011-PL02, 851-10-100-PL02, 851-10-100M-PL02, 851-10-101-PL02, 851-10-102-PL02, 851-10-103-PL02, 851-10-104-PL02, 851-10-105-PL02,  851-10-200-PL01, 851-10-201-PL02, 851-10-202-PL01, 851-10-300-PL01, 851-10-301-PL02, 851-10-302-PL01, 851-10-303-PL01, 851-10-304-PL02 , Daylight and Sunlight Report (24.09.2025) , Flood Risk Assessment (20.09.2020, Ref: WTFR-FRA-2019/08/Q27/Rev B), 225493 - Ransomes Dock, Flood Risk Assessment 'Letter of Comfort' (14.11.2025, Ref: 225493 - MNP - XX - XX - CO - C - 0001), Project Technical Memorandum Ransomes Dock Phase 2 Letter of Comfort for 5 VRF units and 5 Air Source Heat Pumps (23.09.2025, Ref: HT: 32678/PTM1-Rev1), Transport Statement (February 2026), Delivery and Servicing Management Plan (February 2026), Operational Waste Management Plan (February 2026) and Planning Fire Safety Strategy (21.09.2025, Revision 01). 
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory standard of development and to allow the local planning authority to review any potential changes to the scheme. 

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended) or any Order revoking, amending and re-enacting the Order, the area identified on the approved basement floor plan drawing no.  851-10-098-PL01 as flexible Class E/F1 floorspace shall be used only for office (Use Class E(g)(i)) and or art gallery purposes (Use Class F1) and for no other purposes, including any other purpose in Class E or Class F1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended), or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Reason: To safeguard the amenities and of the neighbourhood and to safeguard the sustainability of the focal point of activity by ensuring that other uses which could cause a loss of amenity or commercial function do not commence without prior approval in accordance with Policies LP34  and 35 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023), coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework. 
Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the details shown the approved drawings, no development relating to this S.73 permission (Ref: 2025/3409) shall take place until details and samples of materials proposed to be used on all external surfaces of the development (including the type, colour and quality of any cladding, roofing materials, hardstanding, access bridge/stairs and window details) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved materials and thereafter so retained.
Reason: In order to assess the suitability of the proposed materials, in the interests of the appearance of the locality, in accordance with Policy LP1 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024). It is necessary for the condition to be discharged prior to the commencement of works to ensure suitable materials are used in the construction.
Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the detail shown on the approved drawings, prior to commencement of use of the balconies as shown on drawing numbers [851-10-301-PL02, 851-10-303-PL01, 851-10-302-PL02, 851-10-102-PL02, 851-10-103-PL02] details of screening to the balconies shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The details submitted shall include measurements to ensure that screening shall be to a height of 1.7m above finished floor level and show the obscured glazing material(s) to be used. The screening shall be completed in accordance with the approved details prior to commencement of the use of the balconies and be so retained and maintained thereafter. 
Reason: To protect the privacy of neighbours by preventing overlooking and in the interest of visual amenity in accordance Policy LP2 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).
Condition : 6 - The development shall achieve a maximum water use of 105 litres per person per day (plus 5 litres for outside use) in line with the Water Efficiency Calculator for new dwellings from the Department of Communities and Local Government. Prior to first occupation, evidence to demonstrate that that the internal water consumption of the development will not exceed 105l/p/day must be submitted to the local planning authority and approved in writing, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority. Measures integrated shall be retained for the lifetime of the development. 
Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to accord with Policy LP10 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024). 
Condition : 7 - The development hereby approved shall achieve a minimum of a 19% reduction in CO2 emissions below the maximum threshold set in Building Regulations Part L 2013. Prior to first occupation of the development, evidence (e.g. photographs, copies of installation contracts and as-built worksheets prepared under SAP) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority, to demonstrate that the development has achieved at least a 19% reduction in CO2 emissions below the maximum threshold set in Building Regulations Part L 2013. The installed measures shall be retained in accordance with the approved details unless otherwise agreed by the local planning authority. 
Reason: In the interest of sustainable development and to accord with Policy LP10 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024). 
Condition : 8 - The development permitted by this planning permission shall only be carried out in accordance with the Flood Risk Assessment [Flood Risk Assessment (20/09/2020, ref: WTFR-FRA-2019/08/Q27/Rev B)] approved under planning permission ref: 2019/4915 and the Flood Risk Assessment 'Letter of Comfort' (14.11.2025, Ref: 225493 - MNP - XX - XX - CO - C - 0001) approved under this S.73 planning permission. The second-floor finished floor level must be set no lower than 5.33 metres Above Ordnance Datum (mAOD) and all sleeping accommodation must be located above the breach flood level. All mitigation measures shall be retained as such.
Reason: To reduce the risk of flooding to the proposed development and future occupants, and third parties in accordance with Policy LP12 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).
Condition : 9 - No development shall take place until the following documents have been submitted and approved by the local planning authority in consultation with the Environment Agency: 1. a condition survey of the river wall that identifies any remediation works needed to ensure a life expectancy of at least 100 years; 2. a river wall remediation strategy, if following the condition survey remediation works are required; 3. a river wall raising strategy in line with Thames Estuary 2100 Plan that can be implemented now or in the future; and 4. if opting to raise the defences in the future, evidence demonstrating that the river wall can support this future raising. 
Reason: To reduce the risk of flooding to the proposed development and future occupants, and third parties in accordance with Policy LP12 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).
Condition : 10 - No plant, tanks, lift rooms or other structure shall be erected on the roof of the approved building other than those expressly shown on approved drawing no. 851-10-105-PL02, unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. 
Reason: To control the appearance of the building and safeguard the appearance of the area, in accordance with Policy LP1 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).
Condition : 11 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any Order revoking, amending or re-enacting that Order) no satellite dishes, telecommunications masts, antennas or equipment or associated structures, shall be installed on the building hereby approved. 
Reason: To protect the appearance of the building, in accordance with Policy LP1 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).
Condition : 12 - No pipes or flues, other than rainwater pipes, shall be fixed on the front elevation of the building hereby approved. 
Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the area, in accordance with Policy LP1 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).

Condition : 13 - Prior to the occupation of the development relating to this S.73 permission (Ref: 2025/3409), details and specifications of soundproofing measures including noise insulation and other sound mitigating measures that demonstrate an effective resistance to the transmission of airborne and impact sound and vibrations between the commercial premises and the approved residential flats above shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority. The soundproofing measures shall be installed in strict accordance with the approved detail and prior to the occupation of the development. The measures as approved shall be retailed and maintained as such for the lifetime of the use. 
Reason: To safeguard the amenities of residential occupiers, in accordance with Policy LP27 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024). The details are required prior to commencement of development to ensure the necessary mitigation is incorporated into the construction.
Condition : 14 - Notwithstanding the previously approved details approved in LPA Ref. 2023/4137 (condition 14 details), no works above ground level relating to this S.73 permission (ref: 2025/3409)  shall take place until details of the location, specification, predicted noise levels including any noise and vibration mitigation measures of any external ventilation equipment, including ducting, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority before installation. The external ventilation equipment including ducting shall be installed prior to the commencement of the use in accordance with the approved details and thereafter be so operated and maintained. 
Reason: In the interests of neighbour amenity and visual appearance, and in accordance with Policy LP2 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).
Condition : 15 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved drawings, prior to the commencement of above ground works (excluding demolition) relating to this S.73 permission (ref: 2025/3409), details of the capacity sizes and of refuse and recycling storage and the specific waste streams to be accommodated within the bins serving the commercial and residential development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The refuse storage facilities shall be provided in accordance with the approved details prior to occupation of the development, and shall be retained thereafter. 
Reason: In the interests of amenity and hygiene, in accordance with Policy LP2 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).
Condition : 16 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved drawings, prior to commencement of above ground works (excluding demolition) relating to this S.73 permission (ref: 2025/3409), details of the location, number and design of secure and covered cycle parking shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The cycle parking shall be provided in accordance with the approved details prior to the occupation of the development and be retained for cycle parking purposes for the users of the development and for no other purpose. 
Reason: To ensure adequate provision is made for cycle parking in accordance with Policy LP2 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).
Condition : 17 - No development relating to this S.73 permission (ref: 2025/3409) shall take place until details of landscaping and treatment of parts of the site not covered by buildings, to include the hard landscaping materials, species of new planting/seeding, and any plants/trees to be introduced at the second and third floor levels, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. All planting, seeding, and turfing included in the approved details shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development, or in accordance with a programme agreed in writing with the local planning authority. 
Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance, prevent harm to biodiversity and to ensure biodiversity gain, in accordance with Policies LP55 and LP56 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).
Condition : 18 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the details specified in the Transport Statement (February 2026), Delivery and Servicing Management Plan (February 2026), Operational Waste Management Plan (February 2026) in so far as they relate to delivery and servicing arrangements and waste storage and collection arrangements. Those arrangements shall be retained and operated as approved for the lifetime of the development. 
Reason: To ensure satisfactory delivery and servicing arrangements, to safeguard highway safety and the amenities of neighbouring occupiers, and to ensure appropriate waste management, in accordance with Policies LP2, LP49, LP50 and LP51 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).
Condition : 19 - Prior to first occupation of the development relating to the S.73 permission (Ref: 2025/3409), the rooflights detailed on drawing numbers 851-10-011-PL02 shall be fitted with obscure glazing to a minimum of Level 3 on the Pilkington scale (or equivalent). The rooflights shall be installed prior to first occupation of the relevant part of the development and shall be permanently retained as such thereafter. 
Reason: To safeguard the privacy and amenity of the future occupiers of the approved residential units, in accordance with Policy LP27 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023) coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).
Condition : 20 - INFORMATIVE: In dealing with this application the Council has implemented the requirement in the National Planning Policy Framework to work with the applicant in a positive and proactive manner and the Council has, as far as practicable, sought solutions to problems arising in relation to dealing with the planning application. The Council has made available detailed advice in the form of its statutory policies in the Local Plan (2023) as well as offering a full pre-application advice service, in order to ensure that the applicant has been given every opportunity to submit an application which is likely to be considered favourably. In addition, where appropriate, further guidance was offered to the applicant during the processing of the application.
